title: Access
description: access.yaml at the root of a project: roles as named sets of permissions, the user attributes the model may use, and column restrictions. Users and role membership are never here; they come from `obi serve` options now and an identity provider later (ADR-013).

attributes.description: User attributes the model may read as `user.<name>`, so the identity-provider mapping is explicit. `user.name` and `user.roles` always exist and are not listed.

roles.description: Named sets of permissions. `default` applies to everyone. A user's permissions are the union of `default` and their roles, minus every `deny` of those roles.

columns.description: Columns that only the listed roles may read or write. Other columns follow their entity's `read`/`write`.

type.description: Default `string`. `list` holds several values (`sales_orgs`), used with `in` and `.includes(x)`.

view.description: Dashboards and forms (or sheets) the role may open. A form opened without `edit` is read-only.

edit.description: Forms and sheets the role may submit. Implies `view`.

read.description: Entities whose data the role may read, by name or `*`. Widgets that need an entity the user may not read show "no access".

write.description: Writable entities the role may insert into and update, by name or `*`. Implies `read`.

rows.description: `all`: the entities' `access:` conditions do not apply to this role (administrators).

deny.description: Taken away even when another role of the user allows it.

items.x-error: is not an artifact id or pattern such as `order-*`
is not an entity name or `*`

read.description: Only these roles may read the column. Measures and dimensions that use it show "no access" to others.

write.description: Only these roles may write the column, in forms and sheets of a writable entity.

id.x-error: is not a valid name: use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter

artifact_id.x-error: is not a valid project id: use lowercase kebab-case such as `sales-demo`
